subject: Intro + next steps: Private/VPC deployment demo for MedSecure
body:
From: noreply@redwood.ai
To: kirti@medsecure.health
Date: 2026-07-22T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome — private deployment interest confirmed

Hi Kirti,

Thanks for completing the self-serve form expressing interest in a Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment. Your request has been routed to our solutions team. Someone from Redwood will reach out shortly to schedule a technical walkthrough tailored to regulated deployments.

If you have immediate constraints (audit windows, preferred regions, required compliance docs), reply to this thread and we’ll prioritize.

— Redwood Inference Platform

-----
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Kirti Rao <kirti@medsecure.health>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — private deployment interest confirmed

Hi Kirti — great to meet you. I’m Eve on the Redwood partnerships team; I handle initial intake and scheduling for Private deployments. Thanks for signing up.

Quick notes and asking for one small favor so we can scope the demo:
- Can you confirm whether you’re evaluating VPC-hosted (cloud VPC peering) or a fully on-prem air-gapped install?
- Do you need demo data to be redacted or synthetic? Any PHI constraints?
- What time zone is your security/infra lead in (so we can include them in the technical session)?

Proposed windows (all PST):
- Thu 2026-07-29 10:00–10:45
- Fri 2026-07-30 14:00–14:45
- Mon 2026-08-02 11:00–11:45

You can also grab a spot directly on my calendar: https://calendly.com/evelyn-hart/redwood-private-demo-30m

I’m looping Dev (solutions engineer) to prep a short checklist and a SOC2 snapshot. If you have an NDA or procurement link, drop it here and we’ll upload it to the HubSpot record.

Thanks — look forward to syncing.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf

-----
From: Kirti Rao <kirti@medsecure.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medsecure.health
Date: 2026-07-24T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — private deployment interest confirmed

Hi Eve — thanks, and thanks for the quick follow-up. A few answers below:
- We are primarily evaluating a VPC-hosted deployment (our preferred cloud is us-west-2), but we may need an on-prem option for a pilot environment.
- We will not share PHI in the demo; synthetic data is preferred.
- Our security lead (Anjali Menon) is in PST and would like to join the tech call.

The suggested windows look good — the team prefers Fri 2026-07-30 14:00 PST. I don’t think we need an NDA for the initial walkthrough but I’ve attached a short vendor questionnaire and a note from procurement.

Two asks before the session:
1) Can you share a short checklist of what network access your VPC demo requires (CIDR, ports)?
2) We’d like to see an outline of what you’ll demo for compliance controls (audit logs, KM integrations).

Attaching: MedSecure-vendor-questionnaire.pdf

— Kirti
VP Product, MedSecure Health
attachments: MedSecure-vendor-questionnaire.pdf

-----
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Kirti Rao <kirti@medsecure.health>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-25T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — private deployment interest confirmed

Perfect — Fri 7/30 at 14:00 PST is confirmed. Invites sent to Kirti + Anjali + security. Calendar invite includes a short agenda: 1) intake & requirements (10m) 2) demo focusing on VPC peering and KMS options (20m) 3) Q&A and next steps (15m).

Dev — can you bring the network checklist and a one-slide snapshot of our audit/log retention features? I attached a SOC2 snapshot and a draft SOW template for procurement to start reviewing.

Marissa — I’ve noted this as a potential Qualified lead (MedSecure Health, healthcare, regulated). Can you create the HubSpot deal (RWI-3471) and mark region=us? I’ll add the questionnaire and the SOW to the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Kirti — if anything changes you can reschedule here: https://calendly.com/evelyn-hart/redwood-private-demo-30m (or reply and we’ll adjust). Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
attachments: MedSecure-SOW-template.pdf
